message: You were correct about rename: task.md:66 names pi `set_session_name`, so I drop my host-side `chat_titles` overlay. Your plan leaves out one bug. `read_chat` in `src-tauri/src/agent.rs:438-445` reads only `CHAT_HEAD`, and the test at agent.rs:896 ("Too late") shows that a late `session_info` is ignored on purpose. Pi appends a rename at the end of the file, so in long chats the new title would not show. The fix must also scan the tail of the file for the last `session_info`. Pi can rename only its current session. So the rename of a chat that is not current must first `switch_session` to it, and that also opens it in the UI. This is permitted only when pi is idle, and it starts the VM if necessary. For delete I keep my details: only ids that `list_chats` accepts, a NOFOLLOW|DIRECTORY sessions fd, `statat` regular-file check, then `unlinkat`. If the chat is the current one, send `new_session` first. Use one token-checked `detach_app` so that a stale cleanup cannot clear a newer sink. Implementer stays opus: findings 1, 3, 5 and 8 are in the ShieldMap merge, the rail tree, the dnd-kit keyboard handling and the `attach_app` sink that round 01 wrote. Your plan names files but gives no mechanism for the node merge, the prune gate or the dual drop listeners.
plan: Map (2,3,5,6,7): mapLayout.ts marks `denied:<host>` active when a blocked event for the host is less than ACTIVE_MS old. ShieldMap.tsx removes <Controls>. It adds a Panel with motiv IconButtonGroup that uses useReactFlow zoomIn/zoomOut/fitView. setNodes merges by id: it keeps the existing node object (measured, dragging) unless position or the compared data fields (label, tone, badges, active, title) changed. onNodeDragStop saves {...layout, ...dragged} without a prune. A separate prune effect runs only after the inputs load. ShieldPage passes folders as undefined until listFolders returns, and folder:* ids are kept while folders is undefined. ShieldMap has its own onDragDropEvent. It hit-tests the drop with screenToFlowPosition against the boundary node position plus its measured size, then calls onDropFolder. App.tsx then handles only data-drop="rail". Symlink (4): a Rust command resolve_folder wraps shield::host_dir (commands.rs, lib.rs, api.ts). Both drop paths call it. The SettingsTab mount confirm and the ShieldRail confirm card show the canonical path, plus 'link to <target>' when it differs. The guest name comes from the canonical basename, and the canonical path goes to addMount/createShield. App terminal (8): attach_app returns a u64 token stored with the sink. detach_app(session_id, token) clears the sink only if the token matches. TerminalPane ignores output after dispose, detaches in cleanup, and detaches at once if it is disposed during the await. Draft (9): ShieldPage keeps the ElasticTabs block mounted with hidden in chat/terminal/app views and remembers the tab. ShieldMap calls fitView again when it becomes visible. Row actions (1): ShieldRail gets a motiv IconButton (lucide Ellipsis) per item, and right-click and Shift+F10/ContextMenu open the same menu (motiv Card + ghost Buttons, focus the first item, close on Escape or outside click, no conflict with the tree or dnd-kit keys). Apps: Edit (intent app+appId opens an AppsSection edit draft), Restart, Delete with confirm. Terminals: Close. Chats: Rename via pi set_session_name. If the chat is not current, it first does switch_session to it (only when pi is idle, starts the VM if necessary, opens the chat). Also, read_chat in agent.rs also scans the file tail for the last session_info, so a late rename shows in long chats. Chats: Delete with confirm through agent::delete_chat. It accepts only ids that list_chats accepts, uses a NOFOLLOW|DIRECTORY sessions fd, checks with statat(AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW) that the entry is a regular file, then calls unlinkat. If the chat is current, the UI sends new_session first. App.tsx tracks the current chat per shield from AgentsTab onChat. Rust tests: delete_chat refuses links, directories, bad names and a linked sessions dir. A late session_info is read from the tail. resolve_folder resolves a symlink. A stale detach keeps the new sink. Then run the three gates in task.md.
conceded: Chat rename uses pi set_session_name, as the task specifies, not a host-side chat_titles overlay
Add a Rust test for resolve_folder path resolution
backlog: Rename a chat that is not current without switching pi's open session (needs pi support for naming any session)
